programmes.d: Astro begs a powerful robot not to fight; Astro and Elefun mourn the loss of several robots.
Rubberobo gang-members want to become rock 'n' roll outlaws and run over a woman's shopping bags of anti-aging wrinkle cream.
Rubberobo Gang infiltrates Medabot Corp.
A tree makes Rokusho dream of his past.
The adventures of Ikki and his Medabot Metabee and their hopes to become champions of the Robattle competitions.
After Robattle rankings are announced, Ikki and Medabee become famous.
Kento and Rowen meet up in the subway and search for the others while Talpa enacts a plan to turn the heroes to evil based on his knowledge of their armors' dark origins.

Despite Anubis' previous failure to follow Talpa's orders, Talpa dispatches him to an amusement park where the heroes have gathered; Kento tries to fight without his armor, fearing that using it will turn him against his friends.
The Ancient One reveals the nature of the mystical armors and their relationship to good and evil; as Anubis rethinks his loyalty to Talpa, Talpa's other warlords launch an attack.
The Ancient One helps the heroes reach Talpa's castle and the team faces the combined might of the dark forces in an attempt to break through and face Talpa himself.
Talpa easily defeats Ryo and integrates his warlords' armors into his own form, directly attacking the heroes to steal their armors for himself.
With the powers of all the other armors at his command, Talpa confronts Ryo, the only remaining warrior, who must find a way to defeat Talpa without destroying his captured friends.

programmes.d: Jean tries to prove his worthiness when Nadia asks him to build another aircraft.
When Industria soldiers reach High Harbor, the villagers must band together to defend their home.
Conan and Lana try to evade Industria's soldiers, but Lana is captured.
As the fight for High Harbor continues, Lana fears the arrival of another earthquake.
In the wake of the tsunami, the villagers allow the Industria soldiers to join their community.
Conan is captured; Lana, Dyce, and Jimsy navigate Industria's underground barracks and learn more about life during Lepka's rule.
Conan rushes to stop Lepka from flooding the underground community while Lana contemplates how she can help save the residents.

The gang takes a trip to the mountains to stay at a resort run by Satsuki's cousin Miyuki; upon arrival, a young girl tells them that Miyuki is dead; it seems that her ghost still haunts the frozen lake, turning it blood-red.

Satsuki is asked to perform the after-school broadcast when the previous announcers fall ill; it seems the ghost of a deceased broadcast club member has invaded the system, intent on killing anyone that might upstage her.

A headless rider terrorizes the town on the anniversary of what was his death, seeking to decapitate people like himself; when the ghost turns his headlights upon Satsuki, the gang needs to find a way to put him to sleep again, and quickly.
Ouma intends to kill Kayako's children, Satsuki and Keiichirou; the battle against Ouma will require help.
The El Shank visits an ancient ninja village.
Tensions between Romina and Rennie reach their peak.
The Earth Federation goes all-in.
Joe braves a hostile Earth Federation to retrieve the vaccine.

Rich kid Shutarou Mendou airdrops into Tomobiki High and is a big hit with the ladies, but not so much with the boys; concerned by the daily horoscope, Lum uses a strange device to figure out whether she's better paired with Mendou or her darling.

Lum drags Ataru along to fight in her planet's Setsubun Festival, but the lecher becomes enamored with warrior biker Benten; Ataru tries to use Earth's Setsubun to drive Lum away, but Benten suddenly rides into town with her posse.
Ataru has a new nemesis in the classroom, and Lum has a plan to set things straight; mothers from all over town and the galaxy wreak havoc at parent-teacher conference time.
Ataru suddenly goes missing when Mendou snaps a photo of him using an antique camera; once he's found, Ataru seems to have an extremely lucky day, but there's a catch.
The guys learn that killer intent can make it seem like they are throwing a punch; Kamogawa and Nekota's history with one another is told; Takamura battles a bear; everyone finishes training camp.
Ippo fights with Shigeta, the fourth-ranked among Japanese featherweights; people learn about Takemura's fight with the bear; Takemura is rumored to be in line for a world title match.

Aoki, Kimura and Takemura all fight their fights; before fighting, Takemura makes a grand entrance wearing a bear pelt and fights his match only using his left hand; Nekota starts teaching at the gym for a bit.
Sendo begins his title defense match with Shigeta the southpaw user; Sendo fights Shigeta but gets angry with him as the fight goes on.
Dr. Boynton, a scientist, creates a robot with powers in the image of the son he lost; he creates the robot with a heart.
Toby wakes up at the circus surrounded by the ring master, his employee and the robot star of the circus; Toby is given daily chores and performs a clown act in the show.
Rescued from the circus by Dr. Elefun, Astro Boy struggles with being bullied by classmates.
Astro Boy is tasked with retrieving one of his own blueprint templates from a military fortress.
Astro boy gets involved in Skunk's outer space pirating attempt.
Astro rescues and protects a baby elephant named Pook; Dr. Elephant is asked to re-create Zora, a murderous robot elephant.
